llmJudgeRequirements.description: Row container must set Reanimated `entering={...}` animation (for example `FadeInDown`) on `Animated.View`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Animated.View sets entering={FadeIn.down(200)}, satisfying the structural requirement of an entering animation prop on the row container.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Row container must set Reanimated `exiting={...}` animation (for example `FadeOutUp`) on `Animated.View`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Animated.View sets exiting={FadeOut.up(200)}, satisfying the structural requirement of an exiting animation prop on the row container.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: List rendering must use stable row identity via `keyExtractor`/`key` from persistent item IDs so entering/exiting animations bind to the correct row instances.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: FlatList uses keyExtractor={(item) => item.id} with persistent string IDs (e.g. 'row-1', 'row-2') assigned at creation and never mutated, ensuring stable row identity for animation binding.
